subject: Interactive showcase: multi-prospect time sweep — scheduling
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@dataforge.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@oraanalytics.com>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interactive showcase: multi-prospect time sweep — scheduling

Hi Liam / Priya / CloudOps team,

Thanks for your interest in a joint walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We find running a short, shared technical showcase for a small set of aligned prospects is a helpful way to compare real-world performance and ask model/deployment-specific questions.

Proposed formats (pick one):
- Option A: 45-minute technical demo + 15-minute Q&A (recommended)
- Option B: 30-minute focused demo (core features + integration patterns)

We have the following time windows available next week (all times PDT):
- Tue 6/13: 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 6/14: 11:00–12:00 or 16:00–17:00
- Thu 6/15: 07:30–08:30 (APAC-friendly)

Can you reply with preferred option and up to two time preferences? I’ll consolidate and send a single calendar invite with a Zoom bridge and breakout plan. Attached: agenda_v1.pdf and a quick pre-demo questionnaire (pre-demo-questionnaire.xlsx) — can you fill the questionnaire (one sheet) so we can prepare environment-specific examples? We ask for responses 48 hours before the demo.

Run-of-show highlights: intro (5m) -> architecture + runtime demo (20–30m) -> cost/latency tradeoffs (5–10m) -> integration patterns (5–10m) -> live Q&A.

Ben and Neha are looped for hosting and follow-ups. Vivek will be backup host if we need deeper infra detail.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

Attachment stubs: agenda_v1.pdf (1 page), pre-demo-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — this looks useful. DataForge would prefer an EU-friendly slot if possible (our infra folks in Dublin are best for this conversation). The Thu 6/15 early APAC window may be awkward; could we do Wed 6/14 16:00 PDT (which is Thu 6/15 00:00 CET for us) — that’s late but workable if the length is limited to Option B (30m).

Also, can you confirm whether we can see a short demonstration of private (VPC) deployment and an overview of committed capacity (Dedicated) pricing? If those sections are heavier, we’re open to a follow-up with Redwood infra.

I’ll ask one of our SREs (cc’d internally) to complete the questionnaire.

Best,
Liam O'Connor

- Suggest we set host = Ben (live demo) and co-host = Vivek (deep infra), with Neha doing the commercial close and follow-up cadence.

I can be available Wed 6/14 16:00 PDT. If Priya/OraAnalytics can do the same, we should lock it.
